data.narrative:
Nord Quantique is a seed-stage quantum computing company that has raised C$40M+ to date, including a C$23M financing from Quantum Champions in December 2025. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 comparable companies—3 public (IonQ, Rigetti Computing, D-Wave Quantum) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum and Infleqtion—though few share Nord Quantique's exact stage and valuation profile.

Our valuation analysis applied stage-progression methodology, the only triangulation method with sufficient applicability given data constraints. Using total capital raised (C$40M) as a proxy for post-seed valuation and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to Series A, we derive an implied valuation of $100M. The peer-median method was not applicable; while 6 quantum computing companies exist in our dataset, none meet narrow peer filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) at the threshold of 3+ comparables required for statistical reliability.

Our analysis supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, centered on $100M. This range reflects the stage-progression uplift from confirmed capital deployment. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct same-stage comparables in quantum computing, the nascent and volatile nature of the sector, and the specific technical and commercial traction of Nord Quantique relative to better-capitalized rivals. A fuller valuation would benefit from direct traction metrics and clearer adjacent-stage benchmark data.
